arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Joshua Johnson argued the Eleventh Circuit misapplied the Copyright Act text.
He stated Sections 101 and 103 expressly provide copyright for annotations.
He distinguished editors' notes from other code portions to support his claim.
David Citron argued the government edicts doctrine extends to non-binding documents.
